title: Not 2 quart, not even 1 quart!!
text: Not 2 quart, not even 1 quart!!. As as I like this scoop, the problem is that is not even half the size described. I checked a heaping scoopful and the volume is just under 1 quart.  I thought maybe the sent the wrong one. The label says "Winco SSC2  Small s/s.  When I looked at the dimensions given in the listing, it seemed possible and the SSC-2 model number matched. The problem is the description saying 2 quarts.  I then read through the reviews and no less than 7 reviews pointed out that is was much smaller than stated. A few of these were pretty old yet the description is still wrong. Almost hard to believe that so many of the positive reviewers apparently have no idea what the volume of 2 quarts is. That said, it has a "2 QUART" price.
